claims.text: Documented PCN allergy w/o anaphylaxis: cephalosporins (most often cephalexin, cefuroxime, cefpodoxime or cefdinir).
claims.quote: Cephalosporins are recommended in cases of documented penicillin allergy without a history of anaphylaxis. [50] The most common cephalosporins administered are cephalexin, cefuroxime, cefpodoxime, or cefdinir.
